question: A man takes 2 hours to swim 25 km downstream. He swims 19 km upstream in the same time. What is the speed (in km/h) of the current?
solution:
**Given:**

A man takes 2 hours to swim 25 km downstream

He swims 19 km upstream in the same time.

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/time

Speed of the current = (Downstream - Upstream)/2

**Calculation:**

Downstream speed = 25/2

⇒ 12.5 km/h

Upstream Speed = 19/2

⇒ 9.5 km/h

Speed of the current = (Downstream - Upstream)/2

⇒ (12.5 - 9.5)/2

⇒ 3/2 = 1.5 km/h

**∴ The Required speed of the current is 1.5 km/h**.
